games.name: [☃️XMAS ] Goalbound
games.desc:
Shift - Run
Space - Rainbow Flick
E - Tackle
E Mid-air - Intercept
Space + M1 - Header
Space + Space (IF BALL IS IN AIR) - Other Header 
M1 - Shoot
M1 + A/D - Curve shot
M1 + M2 - Shot feint
M1 + M2 Timed - Parry
M1 Timed - Volley shot(ball needs to be in the air)
Q - Dribble
T - Flow
G - Awaken 

⚽ Goalbound is a Roblox soccer game inspired by the anime Blue Lock, where players compete in intense 6v6 team-based matches to prove they're the best striker. With flashy skills, ego-driven gameplay, and training areas to sharpen your abilities, it captures the competitive, high-stakes spirit of Blue Lock in a fast-paced, anime-styled experience.

Enter a colorful social world where your voice is the center of attention! Indo Voice is our 4th creation, continuing a long tradition of delivering the best social experience. games.name: Blood and Iron
games.desc:
Experience the thunder of cannons, the clash of steel, and the roar of drums as you fight for glory in the legendary Napoleonic Wars. Choose your nation and regiment – from the iconic French Old Guard, to the elite British 95th Rifles. The ability to rewrite history is in your hands!

Featuring:
- 13 nations from across Europe
- Over 35 historical and fictional battles
- 15 different classes, from line infantry to artillery
- More than 300 regiments to pick from

Recent changes:
- Add custom quick words categories

Playing in first person is highly recommended.

games.name: Become a Deep Sea Explorer
games.desc:
🌊 Become a Deep Sea Explorer 🐠
Dive. Discover. Build your underwater empire!

🪸 Dive into an epic underwater adventure where you'll explore mysterious ocean biomes, capture exotic fish, uncover sunken treasures, and build your very own aquarium tycoon!

💦 Dive into Coral Reefs, Kelp Forests, Shipwreck Graveyards, and even glowing Bioluminescent Abysses!

🐟 Catch fish of all rarities using your harpoon — A fun way to gather fish!

💰 Find hidden treasures like gold, jewels, and chests to earn coins fast!

🏛️ Build and expand your personal Aquarium Museum Tycoon — showcase your fish and earn income every second!

📈 Upgrade your breath, swim speed, and luck to dive deeper and catch rarer creatures.

🔄 Trade fish with friends and complete your Fish Index!

🌧️ Dynamic weather and day/night cycles affect what you’ll find — rare fish only appear under special conditions!

💼 Can you catch them all and build the greatest aquarium on Roblox?

👍 Favorite the game and follow for update

⚡ 20 Players. 1 Gun. Can you get it first? Dash to the center and grab the weapon! But be careful—in this game, if you miss your shot, you lose!

🔥 BE THE FASTEST: Race your friends to grab the gun. 
🎯 NEVER MISS: You have limited bullets. If you miss, you explode! 
✨ LEVEL UP: Gain Cash to get exclusive gun skins.

🏆 Can you survive the scramble and be the last one standing?

CONTROLS:
DASH - Q / L1
GRAB / SHOOT - Left Click / Tap Screen / R2
LAY DOWN - C/ Button B/Button O

games.name: SCP: Site Roleplay
games.desc:
Hidden beneath the frozen tundra of Northern Canada lies SCP Foundation Containment Site-64, an ultra-classified facility controlled by an organization that studies and contains the supernatural. Site-64 operates at the brink of catastrophe at all times, facing constant escape attempts by dangerous anomalies, violent sabotage by Chaos Insurgents or Hostile Test Subjects, and a relentless scientific drive to research, even when doing so endangers the world.

Defend the facility as a Security, discover the unknown as a Scientist, endure dangerous experiments as a Class-D, or fight to dismantle the Foundation as an Insurgent or Hostile Test Subject. 

SECURE. CONTAIN. PROTECT.
